title: 生命科学
subtitle: Life Science
keywords: Proteins Structures & Functions 2.Enzyme Inhibitors 3.Immune System 4.Signal Transduction 5.Biological Functions
educationalGoal: Biological functions are expressed by a highly complex system of biomolecules including proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids. Students learn the reaction mechanisms of some enzymes and inhibitors and the intercellular signal transduction system. Students also learn the functions of proteins in immune system and some examples for drug design.
advice: 1. Structures, Functions, and Application of enzymes and inhibitors 2. Intercellular signal transduction system 3. Proteins function in immune system 4. Binding of small molecular ligands 5. Application of biological functions
books: Textbook: Biology and Cell biology, 4th ed. (ed. Masaru Wada), Reference book: Fundamentals of Biological Macromolecules (ed. M. Hasegawa et al.), Reserved bools: not specified
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable that you take basic biochemistry and applied biochemistry. Knowledge of organic chemistry, physics chemistry and analytical chemistry is necessary to understand the function of proteins in biological systems. It is good to read the textbook and to organize the important matters on the summary notebook.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the reaction kinetics of enzyme inhibitors.
Be able to explain the intercellular signal transduction.
Be able to explain the immune system.
Be able to explain the functions of proteins with examples.
Be able to explain the binding of small molecular ligands.
